fields.label: Enforce WMS-Only Stock Movements
fields.description: When enabled, WMS-managed warehouses (any ERPNext Warehouse linked from a WMS Warehouse) cannot receive direct Stock Entry, Delivery Note, Purchase Receipt, or Stock Reconciliation postings from ERPNext's own desk. All stock movement must go through frappe_wms (Goods Receipt / Goods Issue / RF app), which mirrors it into ERPNext automatically. Turn this off only as a temporary escape hatch.

fields.label: Enforce Storage Type Mixing Rules
fields.description: When enabled, a Storage Type's Allow Mixed Products / Stock Types / Batches flags are enforced when choosing a destination bin: a bin already holding a different product/stock type/batch is excluded unless the storage type explicitly allows mixing. Off by default because most existing warehouses have never had these flags reviewed - turn on only after confirming each Storage Type's mixing flags reflect how it is actually used.

fields.label: Require Scan Verification
fields.description: When enabled, confirm_task requires an actual scan (source bin/HU, destination bin/HU, and product) for every field the task has one to check, instead of the check being skippable by simply omitting the scanned value. Off by default - today's RF app already gates this client-side, so most warehouses do not need server-side enforcement; turn on where a bypassed or scripted confirmation would be a real risk.

fields.label: Require Bin Check Digits
fields.description: When enabled, confirming a task against a bin with no Handling Unit also involved (Putaway, Internal Move, Posting Change) asks for the bin's check digits instead of its barcode - a short code printed only on the bin's physical label, never shown in the RF app or any task list, so entering it correctly proves the operator is actually standing at that bin. Off by default: every Storage Bin needs its check digits label printed before this is safe to turn on.

fields.label: Blind Counting
fields.description: When enabled, the RF app and count APIs never return a line's book quantity to the counter before it's recorded - matching SAP EWM's own default RF counting behavior, since a counter who can see the book quantity beforehand tends to just copy it in rather than actually count. The server still compares against the real book quantity either way.

fields.label: Default Handling Unit Type
fields.description: Used by the RF app when a scanned Handling Unit barcode does not exist yet and needs to be auto-registered without asking the operator to pick a type.

fields.label: GS1 Company Prefix
fields.description: GS1 Company Prefix used to build SSCC-18 codes for Handling Unit labels (services/labeling.generate_sscc). Defaults to GS1's own reserved test prefix (0614141) - a label printed with this prefix scans and structurally validates correctly but is NOT a globally-unique real-world identifier. Replace with your organization's actual GS1-issued prefix before relying on printed labels outside this system - this is a config change only, no code change needed.

fields.label: SSCC Next Serial
fields.description: The last SSCC serial reference issued (services/labeling.generate_sscc). Advances by 1 per label; not a WMS Number Range like Handling Unit/Shipment numbering since SSCC has no backing DocType for that mechanism's own collision check to run against.

fields.label: Alert Notifications
fields.options:
Off
Desk Notification
Desk Notification and Email
fields.description: Every hour, supervisors are told about what needs a person: ERPNext postings that keep failing, negative quants, aged task exceptions, requests without tasks, stalled warehouse orders. Only when something changed since the last digest.

fields.label: Alert Recipients
fields.description: One user or e-mail per line. Empty: every enabled WMS Supervisor, limited to the warehouses their User Permissions allow.

fields.label: Keep Stock Ledger Entries (Months)
fields.description: 0 keeps every entry forever. Otherwise, on the 1st of each month, entries older than this many months (at least 12) move to an archive file (WMS Ledger Archive Run) and each stock position keeps one carry-forward entry.

fields.label: Replenish on Removal
fields.description: A confirmed pick that leaves a bin at or below its Replenishment Rule's minimum raises the replenishment immediately, not only in the hourly scan.

fields.label: Zero Stock Check on Pick
fields.description: A pick that empties a bin creates a physical inventory count for it.

fields.label: Require Block Reason
fields.description: Blocking a bin needs a WMS Block Reason.

fields.label: ERPNext Warehouse
fields.description: Auto-created and kept in sync so WMS stock postings can be mirrored into ERPNext.

fields.label: Default Picking Staging Bin
fields.description: Two-Step Picking's shared, order-agnostic first stop (see Warehouse Process Type.picking_strategy) - a Pick task under a Two-Step process type lands here, not the delivery's own staging bin, and a follow-up Sort task moves it on from here once confirmed.

fields.label: Inbound Replication
fields.options:
Manual
Purchase Order Submitted
Purchase Receipt Draft
fields.description: Manual: a user creates the Inbound Delivery (button on the Purchase Order). Purchase Order Submitted: every submitted PO line for this warehouse becomes an Inbound Delivery automatically. Purchase Receipt Draft: a draft Purchase Receipt (an ASN) becomes the Inbound Delivery and the Goods Receipt later submits that same Purchase Receipt.

fields.label: Outbound Replication
fields.options:
Manual
Sales Order Submitted
Delivery Note Draft
fields.description: Manual: a user creates the Outbound Delivery (button on the Sales Order). Sales Order Submitted: every submitted SO line for this warehouse becomes an Outbound Delivery automatically. Delivery Note Draft: a draft Delivery Note (the ECC delivery) becomes the Outbound Delivery and the Goods Issue later submits that same Delivery Note.

fields.label: Release Replicated Deliveries
fields.description: Submit deliveries created by replication so they are ready for execution straight away.

fields.label: Outbound Follow-up on Release
fields.options:
None
Allocate
Allocate and Create Pick Tasks
fields.description: What happens to a released Outbound Delivery without a wave: nothing (a planner allocates later), allocate stock, or allocate and create pick tasks.

fields.label: Order Change Policy
fields.options:
Adapt Until Execution Starts
Block Changes After Replication
fields.description: What an edit or cancellation of the ERPNext order does once it has been replicated: follow it into the WMS delivery while nothing has been allocated/received yet, or refuse it.

fields.label: Close Order Remainder on Short Completion
fields.description: When a delivery is completed short (supplier under-delivered, or the warehouse closed it short), close the ERPNext Purchase/Sales Order so the remainder is not delivered again.

fields.label: ERPNext Posting Mode
fields.description: Synchronous: the ERPNext document posts inside the warehouse transaction, and an ERPNext error stops the warehouse posting. Queued with Retry: the warehouse posts first and the ERPNext document follows in the background, retried automatically and listed in WMS ERP Sync Log if it keeps failing.

fields.label: Stage Components
fields.description: When the component (or kit) stock is moved from storage to the kitting work center by warehouse tasks. Manually: the operator starts it from the RF Kitting screen.

fields.label: Put Away Kitting Output
fields.description: After completion, the produced kits (or components when disassembling) get a putaway task from the work center.

fields.label: Kitting Output HU Required
fields.description: The operator must scan a Handling Unit to put the output on when completing a kitting order.

fields.label: Load Sequence Check
fields.description: Loading a Handling Unit for an earlier stop while HUs for a later stop are still waiting (they belong deeper in the truck): Warn asks the loader to confirm, Block refuses it.

fields.label: Default Slot (Minutes)
fields.description: Length of a dock appointment when no end time is given.

fields.label: Door Changeover (Minutes)
fields.description: Kept free between two appointments at the same door.

fields.label: Trucks Without Appointment
fields.description: At the gate: Allow checks a walk-in truck in, Warn asks to confirm, Block sends it away.

fields.label: No Show After (Minutes)
fields.description: A planned appointment not checked in this long after its start becomes No Show and frees its door. 0: never.

fields.label: Checkpoint Required
fields.description: Arrival and departure at the gate must name a checkpoint (a bin of a storage type with the Checkpoint role).

fields.label: Receipt / Loading Needs Truck at Door
fields.description: A delivery that has a dock appointment can only be received or loaded while its truck is at a door: Warn tells the user, Block refuses.

fields.label: Seal Required at Departure
fields.description: An outbound truck cannot depart without a seal number.

fields.label: Different User to Recount
fields.description: A recount of a physical inventory line must be entered by someone other than the user who counted it first (four-eyes principle).

fields.label: Dangerous Goods Check
fields.description: Enforce hazard-class storage permission, segregation and points limit on destination bins.

fields.label: Source Storage Type
fields.description: Where to pull replenishment stock from (e.g. bulk storage).

fields.label: Range For
fields.options:
Handling Unit
WMS Shipment
Warehouse Order
Warehouse Task
Warehouse Request
Outbound Delivery
Inbound Delivery
Goods Receipt
Goods Issue
Packing Order
VAS Order
WMS Wave
WMS Physical Inventory Count
WMS Quality Inspection

fields.label: Warehouse
fields.description: Leave blank for a range that applies to every warehouse.

fields.label: Handling Unit Type
fields.description: Only used when Range For is Handling Unit. Leave blank for a range that applies to every HU type.

fields.label: Number Length
fields.description: The numeric portion is zero-padded to this many digits.

fields.label: Current Number
fields.description: The last number handed out. Never edit this directly while the range is active.

fields.label: HU Number
fields.description: A number freed by recycling a reusable, empty Handling Unit - handed out again by services/numbering.next_number before the range increments further.

fields.label: Event
fields.options:
HU Created
Putaway Confirmed
Goods Issue Posted
Shipment Loaded
HU Closed
Manual

fields.label: Output Device
fields.description: Must be a WMS Resource with Resource Type = Printer.

fields.label: Print Format
fields.description: Optional. Left blank, the Print Station lets whoever marks it printed choose one at print time.

fields.label: Category
fields.options:
Pallet
Box
Crate
Tote
Trolley
Container
Other

fields.label: Numbering Mode
fields.description: External: the HU number is a pre-printed/scanned barcode supplied by the operator. Internal: the system always assigns the next number from a WMS Number Range, ignoring any number the caller passes.

fields.label: Length
fields.description: Outer size, same unit as Bin Type. With a size on both sides the HU is only put into bins whose Bin Type fits it - no list of allowed HU types per bin needed.

fields.label: Width
fields.description: Outer size, same unit as Bin Type. With a size on both sides the HU is only put into bins whose Bin Type fits it - no list of allowed HU types per bin needed.

fields.label: Height
fields.description: Outer size, same unit as Bin Type. With a size on both sides the HU is only put into bins whose Bin Type fits it - no list of allowed HU types per bin needed.

fields.label: Maximum Payload
fields.description: Heaviest load the HU carries. Copied to new HUs of this type; a HU with a payload refuses more.

fields.label: Use for Cartonization
fields.description: Cartonization may choose this packaging for shipping HUs; limits come from Maximum Weight and Maximum Volume.

fields.label: Levels
fields.description: Ordered smallest to largest (e.g. Each, Case, Pallet). Each level's quantity is how many of the level before it make one of this level.

fields.label: Customer
fields.description: Condition: this spec applies to this customer's deliveries (beats the supplier and generic specs).

fields.label: Supplier
fields.description: Condition: this spec applies to this supplier's goods.

fields.label: Stops
fields.description: Ordered intermediate bins an HU travels through between wherever it's picked/staged and the shipment's door (e.g. a marshalling or consolidation bin for cross-dock). Leave empty for a direct staging-bin-to-door move.

fields.label: Resource Group
fields.description: The pool this physical device belongs to - a Warehouse Queue routes work to a Resource Group, not to one device directly.

fields.label: Resource Type
fields.options:
Operator
Forklift
Reach Truck
Picking Trolley
Packing Station
Scanner
Printer

fields.label: Device ID
fields.description: Physical identifier of the device itself (serial number, MAC address, printer queue name, ...).

fields.label: User
fields.description: Whoever is currently logged on to this device - normally set via Log On in the RF app (services/resource.log_on), not edited here directly, though a Supervisor can still fix it by hand if needed. A Resource models the device, not the person; only one user is logged on at a time, and a Supervisor can Kick whoever's on it.

fields.label: Current Work Center
fields.description: Optional - an operator logs on to a Work Center only when the actions they're about to do need one (VAS generation, Packing, Kitting), so its bin can be defaulted instead of scanned every time.

fields.label: Printer Language
fields.description: ZPL for label printers (Zebra and compatibles), PDF for office printers (agent only).

fields.label: Agent Printer Name
fields.description: The printer name as the agent's computer knows it (e.g. the CUPS queue). Blank = the agent's default printer.

fields.label: Activity
fields.options:
Unload
Putaway
Pick
Internal Move
Deconsolidation
Consolidation
Pack
Stage
Load
Posting Change
Inventory Count
Sort
Cross Dock

fields.label: Activity Area
fields.description: Narrower than Storage Type - a queue matching a task's bin's own Activity Area wins over one matching only its Storage Type.

fields.label: Resource Group
fields.description: The pool of physical Resources (devices) eligible to work this queue - mirrors SAP EWM's Queue-to-Resource-Group link.

fields.label: Sequence Rule
fields.options:
Priority Then FIFO
FIFO
Bin Sequence
Delivery Sequence
Oldest Stock First

fields.label: Door / Staging Bin
fields.description: Only tasks for this door or staging bin (outbound picks of a delivery staged there, loading) are queued here.

fields.label: Route
fields.description: Optional - leave blank to sweep deliveries for every route.

fields.label: Cutoff Time
fields.description: Daily cutoff - a wave generated from this template auto-releases once this time passes for the day, if Auto Release is checked.

fields.label: Minimum Deliveries
fields.description: A wave with fewer deliveries is not released automatically at the cutoff (a supervisor can still release it).

fields.label: Maximum Deliveries
fields.description: A sweep puts at most this many deliveries into one wave; the rest go into further waves.

fields.label: Lock Minutes
fields.description: From this many minutes before the cutoff a Draft wave can no longer be split.

fields.label: Warehouse
fields.description: Optional - leave blank for a default standard that applies to every warehouse.

fields.label: Task Type
fields.options:
Unload
Putaway
Pick
Internal Move
Deconsolidation
Consolidation
Stage
Load
Posting Change
Inventory Count
Sort

fields.label: Item Group
fields.description: Optional - leave blank to match every item group.

fields.label: Standard Seconds per Unit
fields.description: Expected seconds per unit of planned_quantity for a matching task.

fields.label: Base Allowance (s)
fields.description: Fixed time per task (get the equipment, scan, confirm).

fields.label: Travel (s per distance unit)
fields.description: Times the task's own leg (source to destination bin, from the coordinates).

fields.label: Handling (s per kg)
fields.description: Times the task's weight (gross weight per unit x quantity).

fields.label: Personal, Fatigue & Delay %
fields.description: Added on top of the total.

fields.label: Warehouse
fields.description: Optional - leave blank for a default rate that applies to every warehouse.

fields.label: Customer
fields.description: Optional - leave blank for a default rate that applies to every customer.

fields.label: Status Value
fields.description: Runs when the field changes to this value.

fields.label: Condition
fields.description: Python expression over `doc`, e.g. doc.priority == 'High' and doc.warehouse == 'MAIN'. Blank = always.

fields.label: Action
fields.options:
Create Tasks
Send MFS Telegram
Print
Notify
Call Method
Set Field
Create ToDo

fields.label: Parameters (JSON)
fields.description: Print: {"event": "Putaway Confirmed"}. Notify: {"recipients": "a@x.com", "roles": "WMS Supervisor", "subject": "...", "message": "... {{ doc.name }}"}. Call Method: {"method": "Registered name"}. Set Field: {"field": "priority", "value": "High"}. Create ToDo: {"allocated_to": "user@x.com", "description": "..."}. Scheduled: {"filters": {"status": "Open"}}. Send MFS Telegram: {"type": "Telegram type", "values": {"task": "{{ doc.name }}"}}.

fields.label: Execute Once per Document
fields.description: Skip documents this action already ran successfully for.

fields.label: Level Name
fields.description: e.g. Each, Case, Pallet - ordered from the smallest unit up.

fields.label: Quantity of Prior Level
fields.description: How many of the previous (smaller) level make one of this level.

fields.label: Control
fields.description: Required and Read Only are enforced on save (Read Only: not after creation); Required, Read Only and Hidden also shape the form.

fields.label: Allowed Role
fields.description: Blank = anyone who may edit the document.

fields.label: Justify
fields.description: Strings are padded on the right by default, numbers on the left with zeros.

fields.label: Constant
fields.description: A fixed value (e.g. the telegram id, the sender); not taken from the values.
